text: Risk management is the process of identifying, assessing and controlling threats to an organisation. The first step is identifying risks, which means finding possible problems before they happen. Once risks are known, mitigation strategies can reduce their impact or likelihood. For example, a company might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to create contingency plans, so the business knows exactly what to do if something goes wrong. Finally, monitoring is essential. Risks change over time, so regular checks help organisations respond quickly and keep their projects safe and successful.
